scope: Default-off, bounded codec-owned authentication of AC1018 ENTITIES physical source and delivery-manifest publications for explicitly opted-in consumers; no compound, ownership, namespace, output or native support is established.

route.timing: Freeze each physical source immediately before its existing callback; complete and freeze its delivery manifest immediately before its existing later callback. Existing point/entity, physical and manifest callback order is unchanged.
route.authentication: An opaque codec-owned read/section ticket is available only during its exact publication. After a successful read, adapter-retained physical and manifest values must match all frozen scalar, string, variant, span, counter and vector fields, including ignored comments, and match the same ticket owner and pointer. Source-only capture is supported; dropped, copied, duplicated, swapped, altered, exceptional or partial publications cannot establish the retained proof.
route.limits: Scope, record, group, dispatch, event, bytes and work limits are checked before scans, copies and comparisons; every scope reserves work for two worst-case full ticket-scope scans. A caller-provided pointer and shared owner are compared to known tickets before the pointer is dereferenced.
route.compatibility: The reader ledger and AC1018 adapter route are opt-in; default 2D behavior and the previously selectable legacy physical-only facet stay unchanged. Existing modern profile gates are unchanged.

validation.controls: 80 scalar, hidden-state, span and vector mutation checks; eight forged pointer/owner/empty-owner refusals; two ENTITIES sections; seven independently lowered quota boundaries and fresh-reader retries; eight injected freeze-allocation failures; three callback exception and partial-read retries; cross-reader, cross-generation and reentrant refusal; 20 ASCII/binary adapter omission, copy, duplication, tamper and exception cases with fresh-data retries; same-data retry remains refused by existing generation-1 policy; source-only, old physical-only and default opt-out controls. The source fixture is authored locally at runtime.

realSource.result: The shared normal adapter/library captures 185 original records and 165 dispatch proofs; INSERT 704, ATTRIB 705 and SEQEND 706 remain ProfileMismatch. ATTRIB group 10 raw spelling is 920.6796266627232. Control temporarily changes and restores this spelling before forwarding and passes; attack forwards the changed spelling then restores it and both retained captures fail, with no compound audit.

limits: The AC1018 compound profiles and original membership/ownership, APPID/LAYER target roles, full document closure, output, independent CAD semantics and native platform qualification remain separate open work.
The public dxfRW class layout changes and dependent binaries must rebuild; no new DRW_Interface virtual is added.
The retained source fixture is external; no external or generated drawing fixture was committed.
